about_short_description.short_description: Guide Labs is a software development company that builds interpretable models to explain reasoning that are easy to steer, debug, and align.

product.name: Clarity
product.description: A platform for inspecting and understanding how parts of a prompt contribute to an AI model’s output, including concept-level analysis of model behavior.

product.name: Steerling-8B
product.description: An 8-billion-parameter language model with interpretable concept representations for tracing outputs to input tokens, internal concepts, and related training data.

product.name: FineWeb Atlas
product.description: A concept-annotated version of the FineWeb-Edu dataset containing chunk-level labels for content, tone, document purpose, and named entities.

product.name: ATLAS
product.description: A pipeline for annotating large text corpora with human-understandable concepts by extracting tags, consolidating them into a concept library, and training an annotator model.

product.name: Interpretable AI Model Development
product.description: Research and engineering work to build language, generative, and scientific models whose outputs can be inspected, attributed, steered, and debugged through human-understandable concepts.
